title: Safely mix C, C++, and Swift
description: Learn how to mix C, C++, and Swift while improving the safety of your apps. We’ll show you how to find where unsafe C and C++ APIs are called in your Swift code, how to call them more safely, and how to make your app’s existing C and C++ code safer by default.

resources.title: -fbounds-safety: Enforcing bounds safety for C
resources.description: -fbounds-safety is a C extension to enforce bounds safety to prevent out-of-bounds (OOB) memory accesses, which remain a major source of security vulnerabilities in C.
